name: Eyes of Charming

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Charm Person
powers.text: 1 charge: cast Charm Person (save DC 13) on a humanoid within 30 ft.

text: A pair of crystal lenses worn over the eyes, holding 3 charges that all return each dawn. While you wear them, spending 1 charge lets you target a Humanoid up to 30 feet away with Charm Person (save DC 13), provided the two of you can see each other.
